sourceHashScope: relative filenames and bytes of CSS, JS, MJS, HTML, image and font files; excludes editable JSON/Markdown, package metadata, generated dist, host metadata
headings: Add a specimen and name your contribution.
assetPolicy: Original editable vectors for a fictional demonstration; no real user, client or shipped-product evidence.

reviewedEditorial.overview: A single-page case study with a 1440 px content cap, warm paper #f5f2ec, ink #292923 and rust accent #973b2b. A serif hero leads into a paired lead/disclosure area, three-column facts, specimen stages, context, evidence, outcome and credits. An artifact dialog supports closer image inspection.
invariants: Base colors are defined in :root variables in src/styles.css. The print scope overrides --paper to #fff and --surface to #eeece6; additional literal rule colors also exist and are documented by selector.
Headings use the Baskerville/Georgia serif stack; body uses the Avenir Next/Avenir/system-ui stack at 16 px and 1.6 line height. Actual installed faces can differ by viewer.
The source has responsive scopes at 1000 px and 650 px plus print rules. The main reading order runs from #overview through #work, #decisions, #evidence, #outcome and #credits.
adaptationChecks: Inspect desktop, 1000 px and 650 px widths for the lead, facts and evidence grids, then check print pagination and image sizing.
Test the artifact dialog, zoom, keyboard close, visible focus, skip link, transcript disclosure and failed-image fallback after changes.

Keep specimen captions, source status and alt text tied to actual evidence. Confirm replacement asset rights; CSS system font stacks do not themselves establish licensing for redistributed font files.
